description: Bar uptime label with an activity panel: uptime, typing and screen-time line graphs over 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days

barWidget.description: Shows system uptime in a selectable format. Clicking opens a panel with uptime, keyboard and screen-time graphs over the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days, plus format, colour and privacy settings.
